The printed def:walls (SM15 sm-1-polygons.tex:737-776; byte-identical to the SM12 excerpt, not in CHANGES section 1, sm15_reworded=false) defines six mutually exclusive simple wall-germ types plus named side conventions. The Lean definitions denote exactly the printed objects, clause by clause. Wall germ (def:germ, 680-696): `WallGerm` = continuous curve on Ioo(-r,r), Generic off 0, not Generic at 0 (WallGerm.lean:13-19). Z_pt: `pointZeros` = finite set of card-3 index sets with vanishing chi (ZeroTriples.lean:13-14,39-42; `pointZeroTriple_iff` gives {i,j,k} in Z_pt iff chi_ijk=0 for distinct i,j,k). Z_c: `concurrences` = card-3 pairwise-remote sets with a common point in all three `edgeInterior`s (ZeroTriples.lean:61-68; edgeInterior is the open-parameter segment, agreeing with the relative interior also when the edge degenerates). "changes sign at 0": `SignChanges phi` = exists delta>0 (<= radius, harmless by shrinking) with phi(P(t))*phi(P(-t))<0 for 0<t<delta (GermSignChange.lean:10-12), with SignType casts to R for chi/turn. (F) `FlatAt` (NamedWallPredicates.lean:14-17): 4<=n, pointZeros={turnSupport j}={j-1,j,j+1}, concurrences=empty, StrictBetween(mu_{j-1},mu_j,mu_{j+1}), SignChanges(turn j); right/left sides = the side Bool with turn -1 / +1 at every side parameter (NamedWallSides.lean:11-15), with existence/uniqueness and single-parameter characterisation recorded (flat_sides, flat_right, flat_left). (K) `CuspAt` (CuspDefinition.lean:41-45): same supports, mu_j not in the closed segment [mu_{j-1},mu_{j+1}], SignChanges(turn j); the explicit collinearity of the printed text is derivable from {j-1,j,j+1} in Z_pt and is recorded as clause cusp_collinear (turn center j = 0). Newborn pair: `CuspCase` true = mu_{j+1} strictly between mu_{j-1},mu_j giving {cuspFirst,cuspLast}={j-1,j+1}; false = mu_{j-1} strictly between mu_j,mu_{j+1} giving {j-2,j} (CuspDefinition.lean:12-18; newborn_A/B); strictness matches "between" since the three central vertices are distinct under the singleton Z_pt with n>=4. Loop side: `cuspLoopSide` is the Bool side on which the newborn pair is an `IsCrossing` (closed-segment intersection of remote edges, Crossings.lean:12-13), with cusp_loop/cusp_no_loop recording that it is exactly the side where the newborn pair is a crossing at every parameter and the other side has none. Empty cusp: `CuspEmptyAt` = on the loop side the two visits of the newborn crossing (twoStepFirstVisit on edge f, twoStepLastVisit on edge f+2; ThreeEdgeCrossingArc.lean:12-15) are `GaussVisitsAdjacent`, i.e. one is the cyclic successor of the other in the sorted cyclic list of all visits ordered by traversal key edge.val + parameter (GaussCyclicGap.lean:25-26, GaussWord.lean:17-24,84-85, GaussVisits.lean:85-86, Traversal.lean:17) - the printed Gauss-word adjacency; cusp_empty records parameter independence. (E) `ExtensionAt` (36-40): same index/support conditions, mu_M = edgePoint a t for some real t (on the line) and mu_M not in edgeSegment a, SignChanges(chi a (a+1) M). (C) `PureCutAt` (42-44): NoConsecutive {i,j,k} (no element's successor in the set), pointZeros={{i,j,k}}, concurrences=empty, SignChanges(chi i j k). `Silent` = an E or C marking (SilentCenter.lean:23-24); `Simple` = some `HasWallKind` over the six-constructor `WallKind` (WallCenterKinds.lean:11-13,48-56). The main declaration `named_walls_definition` : forall n [NeZero n], 3<=n -> forall g, NamedWallsData hn g, bundles these definitions with proved exclusivity, uniqueness of kind, centre determination, side/parameter independence, unordered-support and relabel invariance; nothing is vacuous and no extra hypothesis narrows the domain.
